full_judgment: 10. Mr. Md. Ashad Ullah has also relied on a decision in the case of Mulla Abdullahbhai and 9 others Vs. Saria Rope Mills Ltd. reported in YID 197 Karachi 597 where it has been held that 'The reason why an application for winding up is not a substitute for a suit, is that in a suit for the recovery of a debt the creditor has to prove what is due to him, whereas in winding up proceedings he has also to establish that the company is unable to pay its debts. The words "unable" does not mean "unwilling" and the word "debts" refers to all the creditors as a class and not separately to the interest of each individual creditor. There should, firstly, exist a debt, secondly, it should not be the subject of an honest dispute and, thirdly, the company should be unable to pay its debts. In the aforesaid 1971 Karachi case it has been held "If a debtor is merely unwilling to pay his debts, then the nor-mal remedy is a suit. If a creditor instead of instituting a suit against debtor-company, files on application for winding it up, one asks himself why has he done so, instead of following the straight forward course of proving his claim directly and then executing the decree? If his del-.t is undisputed, then the decree will fallow easily. If he simply desires to save Court-fee, then the consideration of less to the State revenue may not be in his way, but he involves himself in the problem of proving insolvency of the company which is different from a temporary misfortune of a company. "It is further held "It is wrong to unnecessarily resort to winding up proceedings because there is an implied threat in them to bring disaster to the company and because an odium is also attached to such proceedings. "I respect-fully agree with view expressed in the said decision and I find that bonafide dispute is involved with regard to the amount of debt and the nature debt. I am thus con-strained to hold that the application filed for winding up of the respondent company is not a proper forum for the petitioner. I do not, therefore, find any substance in the winding up petition.
